title: SCA Minhag of the Week 308: "Why Tehilim 67 is in the Shape of a Menorah"

chapters.title: Protection and Hakhamim
chapters.about: Chida and Ben Ish Hai perspectives

summary: This class explores the tradition of reciting Tehillim 67 in the shape of a menorah, a practice common in Sephardic synagogues. It explains the historical significance of this custom, its connection to David HaMelekh, and the proper way to recite it for protection and spiritual focus.
questions: Why is Tehillim 67 written in the shape of a menorah?
How should one properly hold and read the menorah-shaped Tehillim?
What is the spiritual significance of reciting this Mizmor?
Is this practice considered a Sephardic tradition?
How did David HaMelekh use this Mizmor?
